topic: Introduction to Topology: The Geometry of Rubber Sheets

sections.title: Prerequisites: Rigidity vs. Flexibility
lecture_lines: Euclidean geometry focuses on rigid objects.
Angles and distances define rigid shapes.
Imagine a rubber sheet being stretched.

sections.title: The Core Concept: Homeomorphism
lecture_lines: Shapes deform without tearing or gluing.
A circle transforms into a square.
animations: Display a square shape in #2ECC71, appearing as a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mug.svg].

sections.title: The Famous Topology Joke
lecture_lines: Objects with equal genus are equivalent.
A mug deforms into a torus.
animations: Morph the coffee mug [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mug.svg] into a donut [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/donut.svg] shape.
